nodes.label: Design Assumptions
nodes.rationale: Active members only; send accepted <1s with async fan-out; ack optional/independent of RSVP; done means exactly one recipient record per eligible member even after retries; leadership scoped per-local.

nodes.label: Cross-Local Contact Info Privacy Concern
nodes.rationale: Wireman-apprentice contact info question may describe an existing cross-local privacy breach rather than a feature request; should be verified/treated as security incident before unrelated deploys since union membership data is sensitive.

nodes.label: Questions for Denise
nodes.rationale: Assumed: count-only status (no reminders yet), active-only eligibility, single leadership role without extra approval.

nodes.label: Design Data Model (locals/members/users/announcements/deliveries/delivery_events/outbox_events/notification_attempts)
nodes.rationale: Unique (local_id, client_idempotency_key) makes repeated client submission idempotent; unique (announcement_id, member_id) yields one logical delivery per person; delivery_events preserves audit trail; indexes support status counts and inbox queries.

nodes.label: Design Send Path
nodes.rationale: API returns 202 immediately without iterating all members in-request; outbox publisher + fan-out worker inserts deliveries via INSERT ... ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING in batches so it can restart at any point; notification workers log attempts using announcement/delivery ID as dedup key; status screen uses SSE/WebSocket instead of per-row polling.

nodes.label: Rule 1: Isolation and Role Control
nodes.rationale: API never trusts browser-supplied local_id/role; server-verified actor scopes every read/write; centralized permission class for leadership routes; DB row-level security as defense in depth so unscoped queries fail closed; member endpoints require delivery.member_id match.

nodes.label: Rule 2: Retry and Restart Safety
nodes.rationale: Database (not button state/process memory) owns idempotency: send idempotency key stops duplicate announcements, unique (announcement_id, member_id) stops duplicate recipients under redelivery/concurrency; outbox avoids lost queue jobs after commit; workers at-least-once but idempotent; mobile inbox dedups by delivery ID.

nodes.label: Detection and Monitoring
nodes.rationale: Immutable audit events plus monitoring on policy denials, cross-local references, duplicate-key conflicts, fan-out completion, queue age, notification failures.

nodes.label: Design Scope Cuts and Next Steps
nodes.rationale: Log push instead of FCM/APNs; member read/ack APIs instead of member UI; RSVP schema retained but not implemented; production next steps include reminders, device-token lifecycle, rate limits, incident tooling, retention, backups, multi-instance deployment.
